#!/bin/sh
set -e
goal="Update .gitignore for .md backup files"
echo "Plan:"
echo "1. Append .md backup patterns to .gitignore file."

cat >> ./.gitignore << 'EOF'
# Backup patterns for .md files
*.md.backup
*.md.bak
*.md~ 
EOF

echo "\033[32mDone: $goal\033[0m\n"
